credit_line: From the collection of the Rahr-West Art Museum, Gift of Mrs. John D. West
description: Three white limbs of a birch tree extend outward from the bottom center of the canvas. Behind the birch, dark brown pine trees span the length of the composition. Green pine boughs appear to wrap around the birch's trunk and limbs. Soft shapes in red and green form the work's background.
title: Birch and Pine Tree, No. 2
